reviews.comment: 1 blocker: /api/hub/refresh SSRF — probes registrant-controlled e.url with no loopback guard (LOOPBACK_HOSTS gates only the proxy); a LAN peer registers an internal URL then triggers refresh → master fetches it (blind reachability oracle). Fix: filter probe targets to loopback. 6 non-blocking (probe timer leak, token in query, unauth refresh/live callers, broadcast-all, reconcile re-key edge, half-open detection). Rest solid + tested: 333/333.

fix.comment: Fixed blocker: /api/hub/refresh probe now loopback-only (isLoopbackUrl filter) — non-loopback urls never fetched (test proves via fast refresh, no 1.5s hang). Also: clearTimeout in finally (no leak) + centralized isLoopbackHost/isLoopbackUrl helpers shared by proxy + probe. Deferred 5 minor NBs. 334/334.
